Root cause: DetailSection component displayed 'Revenue Composition' title, and FinancialPieChart component also displayed the same title in its CardHeader, creating duplicate labels. Solution: Changed FinancialPieChart title prop from 'Revenue Composition' to 'Overview' to distinguish the chart title from the section title. This maintains the chart's functionality while eliminating the redundant display. All other uses of FinancialPieChart in the codebase (transparency/financial/index.tsx) were verified to NOT have this issue as they use FinancialPieChart directly without DetailSection wrappers. ESLint passes with zero errors and zero warnings.
